purpose: Use the observed ReplicaSSG/FROSS transfer failure to diagnose source-score scale sensitivity and develop a source-scale-robust, recall-preserving fusion rule.

fixed_inputs.source: official FROSS VisualGenome model on the 11 ReplicaSSG official test scenes
fixed_inputs.compatibility: strict train-only family compatibility with Z excluded

source_execution_policy.regenerated_candidate_rows: record the adapter-emitted count and source-prediction hash; do not reject a same-configuration rerun solely for a count difference
source_execution_policy.reason: the official FROSS TensorRT route can emit a small candidate-set variation across regenerated executions; every compared condition must use the same regenerated candidate rows

candidate_fusions.displacement_constraint: decode the fusion ranking under an exact absolute source-rank displacement bound

selection.objective: among guardrail-feasible configurations, minimize Violation@100, then maximize Recall@100, then minimize mean Violation at K=10 and K=50, then use lexical configuration id
selection.internal_estimate: leave-one-scene-out selection on ten scenes and evaluation on the held-out scene
selection.deployment_configuration: repeat the same objective on all eleven development scenes

claim_boundary: The output is method-development evidence. Any selected configuration requires evaluation on another untouched target before it can support a new prospective or dataset-generalization claim.
